news.title: Retirement Practice Community: Longevity Linked Securities
news.summary: Mark Shemtob, FSA, MAAA, CFP®, sits down with Dario Fusato, Co-Founder of Savvly. Savvly has registered its new security offering with the Securities Exchange Commission. Mark and Dario's conversation includes a description of the security, why it was developed, where it will be available and future related securities.
news.whyItMatters: Relevant to mortality/longevity assumptions, experience studies, pricing, and reserves.

news.title: Health Community: Rebalancing Risk in Gene Therapy & High-Cost Pharmaceuticals
news.summary: Host Danny Moore, FSA, MAAA, CERA and guests John Nolan and Marc Marion from Octaviant Financial discuss the challenges of specialized high-cost drug treatments, their efficacy, and potential vehicles to manage the unique risks involved with these treatments.
